content.announcement: Complimentary insured shipping on orders over ₹10,000
content.heroText: Thoughtful pieces in gold, silver, and natural stones. Made for your moments, and the ones still to come.
content.storyTitle: Made with care. Chosen by you.
content.storyText: We believe the pieces you wear should feel personal. Each design is made with carefully chosen materials and considered details, ready to become part of your story.
content.footerText: Considered jewelry for everyday and every occasion.
content.shippingPolicy: Insured shipping is complimentary on orders over ₹10,000. The store team will confirm the delivery estimate after reviewing your order.
content.returnsPolicy: Contact the store within 7 days of delivery to ask about an unworn item's return or exchange. Custom and engraved pieces may have different terms.
content.carePolicy: Keep jewelry away from perfume, lotions, chlorine, and harsh cleaners. Store pieces separately and wipe gently with a soft cloth after wearing.
content.privacyPolicy: We use the information you provide to process orders and respond to your requests. This starter site stores order and account information locally on the store server.
content.termsPolicy: Product availability, delivery timing, and final payment arrangements are confirmed by the store team. Product images and colors may vary slightly by screen.
